## Company Overview
ZEALL (NANTONG ZEALL NEW MATERIALS CO., LTD.) is a leading FRP grating manufacturer based in Nantong, China with 20+ years of manufacturing experience. We specialize in molded and pultruded fiberglass grating, FRP covers, handrail systems, pultruded profiles, and custom composite solutions.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2004
- Location: Nantong, Jiangsu, China
- Employees: 200+
- Annual Capacity: 10,000+ tons/year

- Warranty: 20+ years

## Product Line
1. Molded FRP Grating - 25/30/38/50mm thickness, 38x38/40x40mm mesh, polyester/isophthalic/vinyl ester resin
2. Pultruded FRP Grating - Heavy-duty I-bar/T-bar, high load capacity, long spans
3. FRP Covers & Panels - Solid top, covered grating, trench covers, tank covers
4. FRP Pultruded Profiles - I-beams, channels, angles, tubes, flat bars
5. FRP Handrail & Stair Systems - Complete modular safety systems
6. Fiberglass Fabric - Woven roving, C-glass, E-glass
7. Grating Clips - M-clip, C-clip, Z-clip, stainless steel
8. Custom FRP Solutions - OEM/ODM, custom fabrication, engineering support

## Resin Systems
- Polyester (Orthophthalic) - General purpose, cost-effective
- Isophthalic Polyester - Better corrosion resistance, wastewater applications
- Vinyl Ester - Maximum chemical resistance, acid/alkali environments, marine
- Phenolic - Fire retardant, low smoke, high voltage insulation

## Surface Options
- Concave/Meniscus - Standard, moderate slip resistance, easy to clean
- Smooth - Polished, decorative
- Grit/Quartz - Maximum slip resistance (R13), heavy traffic areas
- Solid Cover - Waterproof, sealed surface

## Applications & Industries
- Water & Wastewater Treatment - Walkways, platforms, tank covers
- Chemical Processing - Acid/alkali resistant flooring, platforms
- Oil & Gas - Offshore platforms, refineries, FPSO
- Marine & Shipbuilding - Ship decks, dock gangways, offshore structures
- Power Generation - Power plants, substations, transformer areas
- Mining & Mineral Processing - Processing plants, conveyor walkways
- Food & Beverage - Wash-down areas, drainage covers
- Pharmaceutical - Clean rooms, chemical storage
- Pulp & Paper - Bleaching plants, chemical areas
- Transportation - Bridges, pedestrian walkways, railway platforms
